menu_categories.name: Authentic Kenyan Classics
menu_categories.description: Traditional slow-cooked stews, Lake Naivasha fresh fish, and hearty local staples.

menu_categories.name: Continental & International

menu_categories.name: Bites, Starters & Sides

menu_categories.name: Hot & Cold Beverages

menu_items.name: Nyama Choma - Mbuzi (1 Kg)
menu_items.description: Tender prime goat meat flame-roasted over charcoal, seasoned with sea salt and served with fresh spicy kachumbari and ugali.

menu_items.name: Nyama Choma - Mbuzi (1/2 Kg)
menu_items.description: Half kilo of succulent charbroiled goat ribs & loin, served with kachumbari and roast potatoes or ugali.

menu_items.name: Kuku Choma - Full Chicken
menu_items.description: Whole chicken marinated in ginger, garlic, lemon, and Kenyan herbs, grilled over slow coals.

menu_items.name: Kuku Choma - Half Chicken
menu_items.description: Half grilled chicken served with a side of chips or ugali and chili-lemon kachumbari.

menu_items.name: Miami BBQ Pork Chops & Ribs
menu_items.description: Glazed pork ribs caramelized with Miami honey-garlic BBQ reduction, served with seasoned wedges.

menu_items.name: Lake Naivasha Deep Fried Tilapia
menu_items.description: Fresh whole Lake Naivasha tilapia deep-fried crisp, smothered in rich tomato-onion-coriander gravy, served with white ugali & sukuma wiki.

menu_items.name: Beef Wet Fry (Karanga)
menu_items.description: Tender diced beef sauteed with red onions, ripe tomatoes, sweet capsicum, and fresh coriander. Choice of chapati or ugali.

menu_items.name: Special Kuku Kienyeji Stew
menu_items.description: Free-range indigenous chicken slow-simmered in aromatic broth with fresh rosemary and garden vegetables.

menu_items.name: Swahili Pilau ya Nyama
menu_items.description: Fragrant basmati rice infused with whole cloves, cumin, cardamom, and cinnamon, cooked with soft beef chunks and served with chilled kachumbari.

menu_items.name: Matoke with Beef Stew
menu_items.description: Highland green cooking bananas stewed to perfection with tender beef, carrots, and sweet bell peppers.

menu_items.name: New Miami Special Beef Burger
menu_items.description: Double grilled beef patty, melted cheddar cheese, caramelized onions, crisp lettuce, gherkins, and house special sauce in a brioche bun. Served with crispy fries.

menu_items.name: Creamy Tuscan Penne Chicken Pasta
menu_items.description: Al dente penne pasta tossed in rich garlic parmesan cream sauce with grilled chicken breast, sun-dried tomatoes, and basil.

menu_items.name: Crispy Naivasha Fish & Chips
menu_items.description: Golden beer-battered fresh lake fish fillets served with homemade tartar sauce, lemon wedges, and hand-cut chips.

menu_items.name: Crispy Beef Samosas (3 pcs)
menu_items.description: Golden pastry pockets stuffed with minced spiced beef, spring onions, and coriander. Served with sweet tamarind dip.

menu_items.name: Kenyan Masala Chips
menu_items.description: Crispy potato fries tossed in a spicy, tangy tomato-garlic masala sauce with fresh chopped coriander and lemon zest.

menu_items.name: Mukimo Special Side
menu_items.description: Traditional mashed potatoes with soft sweet corn, green pumpkin leaves (kahurura), and yellow beans.

menu_items.name: Flaky Layered Chapati (Pair)
menu_items.description: Two soft, pan-fried Kenyan chapatis with golden flaky layers.

menu_items.name: Fresh Garden Kachumbari
menu_items.description: Diced ripe tomatoes, red onions, fresh coriander, green chili, and lemon dressing.

menu_items.name: Kenyan Chai Masala (Pot)
menu_items.description: Rich whole-milk tea brewed with freshly crushed ginger, cardamom, cinnamon, and cloves.

menu_items.name: Special Naivasha Dawa
menu_items.description: Hot revitalizing blend of fresh crushed ginger, local organic honey, freshly squeezed lemon juice, and hot water.

menu_items.name: Fresh Naivasha Passion Juice (500ml)
menu_items.description: Chilled freshly blended sweet-tangy passion fruit juice without artificial preservatives.

menu_items.name: Tropical Mango Smoothie
menu_items.description: Thick mango puree blended with yogurt, crushed ice, and a dash of honey.
